Domain: Spiritual — Resource: Mana — Specialty: Full Manifestation — Specialty Condition: Broken

Supernatural bonds between a character and entities, forces, ancestors, spirits, monsters, or other manifested powers. Most Calling Actions channel only a portion of the entity's power (a claw, a breath, an aura, borrowed senses, and so on) without summoning a separate creature.

Full Manifestation

A Calling Action's fixed Rider may offer Full Manifestation. When its printed requirements are met, pay the listed cost to bring the manifestation fully into the Encounter: it replaces the character on the battlefield, appears in the character's space, and uses its own Actions, Reactions, combat profile, and Wound Track. The character and manifestation share timing/Turn purposes unless stated otherwise. Damage while manifested applies to the manifestation's own Wound rules and persists when dismissed. If the manifestation is defeated, the bond suffers a serious disruption and the character may become Broken, losing access to that manifestation family until the bond recovers.

Expertises

  • Accord
  • Dominion
  • Vessel
  • Anchoring
  • Banishment
  • Chorus
  • Transference

Subtypes

  • Rank 0 — Familiar, Sprite
  • Rank 1 — Beast, Phantom, Golem
  • Rank 2 — Elemental, Ancestor, Fey
  • Rank 3 — Dragon, Fiend, Celestial
  • Rank 4 — Abomination, Leviathan, Avatar
  • Rank 5 — Outsider, Titan, Primordial
